info.title: Academy LMS
info.description:
The API of the family and teacher apps (one shared app for every academy, or an academy's own).

**Which academy.** A request is for one academy: the bearer token decides it once signed in; before
that, send `X-Academy: {slug}` (or call the academy's own host). Finding one's accounts
(`/v1/accounts/code`, `/v1/accounts/code/verify`) needs no academy.

**Signing in.** `POST /v1/auth/login` (password), or a one-time code: `POST /v1/auth/code`, then
`/v1/auth/code/verify`. The shared app starts with discovery: `/v1/accounts/code`,
`/v1/accounts/code/verify` (the person's accounts in every academy), then `/v1/accounts/sign-in` for
each one it adds. Each sign-in answers a token: send it as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

**Times.** Every instant is `{utc, local, timezone, label}`: `local` and `label` are in the viewer's zone
(`X-Timezone` with an IANA name, else the profile's, else the academy's). Weekly times and leave are on
the teacher's clock.

**Language.** `Accept-Language: ar` or `en`; labels and errors come back in it.

**Errors.** RFC 7807 (`application/problem+json`): `type`, `title`, `status`, and `errors` per field
for a 422.

**Retries.** Writes that move money or lessons take an `Idempotency-Key`: the same key answers the
first response for a day; the same key with another body is a 409.

get.description:
For the student themself (learner_id left out) or a guardian's child. Each challenge has its target, progress and
state: active, missed, done (ready to collect, by the student) or claimed. Rewards finished last week or last month
come first while they can still be collected. cheers: the guardians' cheers the student has not seen yet.

The student collects a challenge they finished (challenge and period as listed). Its points add to theirs; the
kids' chest also brings the next sticker. Once only. Send an Idempotency-Key.
